newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican Zapatistas, Chicanos meet in the jungle.
newsitem.headline: Mexican Zapatistas, Chicanos meet in the jungle.

text.p: In an act of "cultural resistance", hundreds of Chicano supporters met with Mexican Zapatista rebels in this poor southern state on Tuesday.
Commandante David and more than 50 indigenous leaders of the Zapatistas met the visitors with bright native attire, but kept their characteristic face masks donned for the gathering.

"We hope this meeting of different ideas and thoughts, different hearts, experiences and cultural riches serves to build unity ... for the common fight to rescue, defend and conserve the best of our culture," the Zapatista leader said.
Nearly a year ago Commandante David led the Zapatista delegation that suspended peace talks with the Mexican government.
The Chicanos travelled to this remote village in Chiapas state, mostly from Chicago and Los Angeles, for a five-day cultural celebration of regional music and dance.
